authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: Turner oṣati explicitly records Khowar uṣák cold beside Dameli oṣé- to be frostbitten. The survey uṣak forms match that cited Khowar word. The apparently unusual burn/cold semantic history is Turner’s explicit comparison, not an inferred equation with warm uṣṇa.
